notes.title: Shield Shock v2.0 [FULL VERSION] - PATCH NOTES:
notes.notes:
[b]Shield Shock v2.0 [FULL VERSION] - PATCH NOTES:[/b]

[i]( March 20th 2020 )[/i]


[b]NEW CONTENT:[/b]
• [NEW] HORDE WAVES: Every 10 Waves in Arcade Mode will Empower All Enemies with Enchanted Effects.
• [NEW] STAMINA BAR: The Stamina Bar will also be Added to the Header Above Your Character.


[b]ENCHANTED ENEMY BUFFS:[/b]
• Red = Damage +++ | Health +

• Blue = Damage + | Health +++

• Yellow = Health + | Movement Speed + | Attack Speed ++


[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
• Can No Longer Heal While Player Is Dead
• Minor Bugs + Glitches Fixed with Level Completion



[i]Thanks For Playing! <3[/i]

notes.title: Shield Shock v1.2 [CHARACTER UPDATE] - PATCH NOTES:
notes.notes:
Shield Shock v1.2 [CHARACTER UPDATE] - PATCH NOTES:

( February 22nd 2020 )


NEW CONTENT:
• [NEW] Tiki: New Playable Hero Has Been Added To The Roster!
• [NEW] Golem: New Playable Hero Has Been Added To The Roster!


MENU CHANGES:
• Hero Title Cards Have Been Added To The Controls Menu (Stats + Descriptions Added For Every Hero)


CHARACTER UPDATES(Nerfs, Buffs, Changes):
• [NEW] Tiki: New Playable Hero Has Been Added To The Roster!
• [NEW] Golem: New Playable Hero Has Been Added To The Roster!
• [CHANGE]   Wizard: Down Air Projectiles Have Added Visual Effects


BUG FIXES:
• Frost Orbs [Frost Tower Projectiles] Can Now Go Through Drawbridge Map (From Above + Below)


NEW CHARACTERS:

• "GOLEM" the Energy Boxer - The Golem will unleash quick bursts of energy to attack foes for a Close-Combat Playstyle.
Features:
- Attack in all directions for precise swings at your opponents.
- Perform Double Jumps for an easy time maneuvering the stages.
- Destroy projectiles with your energy punches and your Special Ability: "Crystal Barrier".
- Store energy from blocking incoming attacks and using your Crystal Barrier ability.
- Power up your Hero for a limited time by storing energy.

• "TIKI" the Voodoo Magician - Tiki will be utilizing her Magical Totems and Poisonous Darts to control the battlefield.
Features:
- Shoot Poisonous Darts to slow down Enemies.
- Create Totems (Shoot [Aiming Down] While On Ground) to inflict damaging Pulses into Poisoned Targets nearby.
- Quick Hero with Low Cooldowns.



Check Out The Content Here: [url=https://youtu.be/Eeb0lTQActI]New Content Overview[/url]



Thanks For Playing! <3

notes.title: Shield Shock v1.1 [TOWER UPDATE] - PATCH NOTES:
notes.notes:
Shield Shock v1.1 [TOWER UPDATE] - PATCH NOTES:

( January 26th 2020 )


NEW CONTENT:
• TOWERS HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE GAME!
• ENJOY RARE CURRENCY DROPS AND SECRET SHOPS IN THE ARCADE MODE!

GAMEPLAY CHANGES:
• Projectile Hit Boxes Are Improved


CHARACTER UPDATES(Nerfs, Buffs, Changes):
• [CHANGE]   Dragon: Damage Scales Less With Powering Up Shots [7,13,20 -> 8,12,16]
• [BUFF]         Dragon: Attack Speed Increased
• [NERF]         Dragon: Lava Step - Lava Creation Timer Decreased

BUG FIXES:
• Powerups Can No Longer Get Stuck In Walls
• Projectiles Can No Longer Be Destroyed On Shooting Near A Wall
